source: segmentation (simulation footage, background replaced by white)

camera.background: uniform white (segmentation), no ground, horizon or other features; no background shift measurable or expected

objects.name: ball
objects.description: the only object: a light-grey (RGB ~234) disc/sphere mask on a white background; frame 0 shows a small darker grey sliver at the left edge
objects.reference_point: cx,cy = bbox midpoint (= centre of the disc, the object origin); for clipped frames 0-1 cx = bbox_x1 - 24

diameter_px.note: edges are soft/low contrast; true diameter about 49 +/- 2 px; equivalent-area diameter ~49-50 px

objects.motion: straight horizontal motion to the right along y ~ 555-557 px; enters from the left edge at frame 0; still on screen moving at frame 50 (cx = 1451); per-frame step falls from ~33 px/frame (frames 2-10) to ~26 px/frame (frames 45-50), i.e. steady deceleration; vertical drift < 2 px over the clip

events.event: ball enters frame from left edge (already moving)
clip ends with ball still moving right, decelerating, no contact/bounce

no_events: no bounce, impact, collision, direction change or stop in the clip
